$f0_L-Fkt6RF_29WumKiF7HVXCFlv_sjqttD7ncY.name: The Timberbox
$f0_L-Fkt6RF_29WumKiF7HVXCFlv_sjqttD7ncY.description: Only a handful of Timberboxes were ever built, combining a heavy four-wheel-drive chassis with an enormous cabin constructed from wood. One enthusiastic carpenter even fitted a small sauna in the back, making for happy passengers when waiting for rescue while stuck.
